summary: Retest of Playspintech multi-tenant backend after main agent's route-ordering fix. All 28/28 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant.py now PASS (previously 20/28 in iteration_2). The seed-defaults endpoint is now correctly registered, and GET /api/ returns {app,status} with HTTP 200.

minor.issue: Still silently returns 200 on scope-miss instead of 404. Not a data leak (isolation preserved), but a confusing contract. Was flagged in iteration_2, remains unaddressed. Non-blocking.

verifications.fix_1_seed_defaults_route_registered: PASSED — POST /api/admin/sites/{sid}/seed-defaults now returns 200 and correctly seeds 8 kasalar + 11 payment methods + 4 debtors on a fresh site. Second call on same site returns 400 as expected.
verifications.fix_2_root_endpoint_shape: PASSED — GET /api/ returns HTTP 200 with body {"app":"Playspintech Finance","status":"ok"} (not 422; no stray site_id dependency).
verifications.regressions_from_iteration_2_all_8: All 8 previously-failing tests now pass (test_seed_defaults_for_new_site, test_seed_defaults_fails_if_site_has_data, and the 6 downstream tests that depended on the seeded testsite).

action_items: OPTIONAL (carried over from iteration_2): Add explicit 404 to DELETE endpoints on scope-miss for API hygiene.

OPTIONAL: /app/backend/pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. This test file shares a module-level STATE dict across classes and REQUIRES serial execution — must be run with `-n 0`. Running with defaults produced 23 phantom failures due to STATE not being shared across xdist workers. Consider either (a) pinning this file to a single worker via `pytest.mark.xdist_group` on all classes, or (b) documenting in the test file docstring that `-n 0` is mandatory. Report reflects the required `-n 0` run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1156-1175 — seed-defaults endpoint now correctly precedes app.include_router(api_router). Fix is clean and minimal.
server.py:1170 root endpoint no longer takes any path/query params — good.
Pre-existing (iteration_2) DELETE silent-success pattern still present in server.py; no regression, no fix.
seed_data_creation: Test suite is self-contained: creates a TEST_TestSite + one TEST_siteuser_<epoch>@example.com user, seeds defaults into it, then cascade-deletes it at the end. Cleanup verified: after successful run only Etobahis remains. Pre-run I manually cleaned up one leftover TEST_TestSite from iteration_2's failed run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend multi-tenant flow is fully green. To rerun: `cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://gaming-ledger-pro.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_multitenant.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. MUST use `-n 0` because tests share a module-level STATE dict across classes; xdist's loadscope splits classes across workers and breaks state. If a TEST_TestSite is left over from a broken prior run, delete it via `DELETE /api/admin/sites/{id}` with admin bearer token before rerun.
